Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix critical bugs in user invitation and role assignment

Issues Fixed:
1. Invited users now correctly join the inviter''s organization
   - Added organizationCode field assignment from invitation
   - Prevents creating duplicate organizations for invited users

2. Roles now properly assigned to invited users
   - Set both role (string name) and roleId (ObjectId) fields
   - invitation.role is populated object, so use .name and ._id
   - Fixes "No Role" and "Unknown Role" display issues

3. Fixed registration flow role assignment
   - Changed from role: adminRole._id to role: adminRole.name
   - Added roleId: adminRole._id for new role system
   - Ensures proper role assignment during registration

Root Causes:
- User model has dual role system: role (String) and roleId (ObjectId)
- Invitation acceptance was assigning entire role object to string field
- Missing organizationCode caused users to appear in wrong organization
- Registration was assigning ObjectId to string role field

Impact:
- Invited users now appear under correct organization
- Roles display correctly in user management
- No more duplicate organizations per user
- Consistent role assignment across all user creation flows

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix user role display, delete user, and invitation management issues

Issues Fixed:
1. Role display now showing correctly in users table
   - Added .populate(''roleId'') to user fetch queries
   - Map response to include role as roleId for frontend compatibility
   - Frontend now displays actual role names instead of "No Role" or "Unknown Role"

2. Delete user functionality fixed
   - Changed deprecated user.remove() to user.deleteOne()
   - Prevents errors when deleting users

3. Resend invitation authorization improved
   - Now checks both req.user.role and req.userRoleName
   - Supports multiple role name formats (admin, Admin, super-admin, Super Admin)
   - More robust authorization check

Root Causes:
- Backend wasn''t populating roleId field when fetching users
- Frontend expected ''role'' field but backend was only setting ''roleId''
- Deprecated Mongoose method (remove) was being used
- Authorization check was too strict and didn''t account for role variations

Impact:
- Users now display with correct roles in UI
- Delete user button works properly
- Resend invitation and cancel invitation work for authorized users
- Better backward compatibility with role system

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
